name: Male 01 (radio wry)
sounds_like: Mid male, median pitch 120 Hz, moving over a wide 12-semitone range so the line rises and falls constantly. 9.7s reference with almost no gaps in it - longest pause 0.12s, silence only 3% of the clip - so it runs on, phrase into phrase, taking breath without stopping. Mid-bright timbre (centroid 1469 Hz), no rasp, no audible breath. Source line is radio-presenter patter with a dry joke in it, so the lilt is wry rather than warm.
casts_well_as: Lead male, protagonist, radio or TV host, wry everyman, banter, someone who talks to fill a silence.
avoid_for: Lines that need space and stillness - the reference never pauses and clones inherit that push. Also weak for gravitas, menace, or age; at 120 Hz it sits too high and too mobile.
